description:
Get one entity's DECRYPTED content by name_hash (SHA-256 of the normalised name).
    Content scope required (403 otherwise).

name_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the entity's normalised name. Send it: without it the plan has no entity filter.
name_hash.title: Name Hash

node_id.description: Accepted for compatibility but NOT used yet: the lookup is by name_hash only.
node_id.title: Node Id

name: get_entity_content
